newsitem.title: GREECE: XANTHAKIS APPOINTED HEAD OF REUTERS HELLAS.
newsitem.headline: XANTHAKIS APPOINTED HEAD OF REUTERS HELLAS.

text.p: Catherine Xanthakis has been appointed Business Manager of Reuters Hellas, succeeding William Cairley who moves to a senior position at Reuters headquarters in London, Reuters announced on Thursday.

Xanthakis holds degrees in business administration from the University of Economic and Business Studies (ASOEE) and the American Deree College in Greece and has held managerial positions in Greek and international firms during her career.

Xathakis was appointed finance and administration manager at Reuters in 1998 and was promoted to deputy general manager and member of the board of directors in 1992, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
